name: Stack
description: Vertical flow: adds space between consecutive children. The default way to space components vertically.

values.name: sm
values.description: Tight spacing (0.5rem), e.g. form-field internals or list items.

values.name: lg
values.description: Loose spacing (2rem), e.g. between page blocks.

use: Nest stacks with different gaps to build rhythm.
avoid: Adding margin-top to children to fix spacing; change the stack modifier instead.
